name: stick pass around stretch
description: Swinging a stick from front to back in a wide arc to open up the shoulders. A classic warm-up for shoulder mobility.
instructions: Stand tall and hold the stick in front of you with a wide overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and raise the stick overhead.
Carry it back behind your body in a smooth arc.
Return the same way to the start.
Repeat for 8-10 slow passes and narrow your grip as you get more flexible.
